what: crates/blaze-cargo/src/toolchain.rs:229-234 finds the sysroot by scanning rustup's toolchains/ directory, and it is reached from Front::compile via sysroot() on a pool worker. Blaze is its own toolchain (AGENTS.md rule 6, own-nightly): it should take the sysroot from its pinned nightly (harness/toolchain), fixed at daemon start as an input, never from rustup. Found while listing the IO reachable from job code: docs/v2/plan/lanes/sched/io.md, section Found on the way.

history.note: toolchain.rs sysroot() now returns Option<&static Path>, looked for once and fixed for the process; serve.rs resolves it at daemon start, before any job, and refuses to start without it (error names `blaze toolchain`). A job task (codegen.rs sanitize and link) only reads the OnceLock: no directory scan, no allocation. The release is always the pinned harness/toolchain nightly; rustup is only one place its identical files may already be on disk (nothing rustup selects is read: no RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN, no rust-toolchain files).
